selection_reason: Designs a looped causal encoder-decoder whose encoder recurrence shares the last round KV cache losslessly, achieving zero round-wise KV growth and 1/6 of a looped transformer global KV, validated by looping the 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for serving.
title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
